Title: SPECIFIC COMPONENT CERTIFICATION REQUIREMENTS

A8. Details of technical deviation requested: (Attach continuation sheets) if necessary)

Requirement:

- According to the Project Specification VEN-4151-DGTYP-0-04-0001, rev.A, Clause 9-(1) Any other Wetted components exposed to sour service shall be supplied with EN 10204 type 3.2 certification.
- According to the QP Standard QP-STD-R-001, Rev.3 ,Sec 17.2-b(ii) Small quantities of materials and materials that are sourced from a Stockiest /Trader, where verifiable EN 10204 type 3.2 certification is not available and this is confirmed by the QP Engineer, can be sourced with EN 10204 type3.1 certification issued by the material Manufacturer, followed by the verification tests and inspection specified in Sub-clause 17.4, witnessed and certified by a QP approved TPCA.

Deviation:

)Valve Internal (trim) parts certified type 3.1 without verification tests for FM & KM

2)Valve Internal (trim) parts certified type 3.1 with chemical Verification test for KN

A9. List of affected areas where deviation is proposed to be applied: List by tag no(s). equipment no(s). system no(s) and documents affected by this TDR (Attach continuation sheets) if necessary)

Anti-surge Valves supplied by Dresser for BH jobs 5841561 (FM), 5841562 (KM), SCC0248 (KN). See attachment 2.

A10. Reason for requesting deviation: (Explain why complying to Project Specifications is not achievable)

- As this Valve Trims Parts of Anti Surge Valves are small in size & Quantity(Refer Attachment 2) and have in assembled Condition & not feasible to perform Verification test except chemical analysis for KN Valves J
- As per QP std. (QP-STD-R-00 1 Rev.3) Clause 17.1.3b) there are, however, situations where it is difficult to comply with these EN

10204 type 3.2 certification requirements. Typically, these are when there are time constraints, availability problems, inability of suppliers to provide type 3.2 certification for materials, for specific types of the component or equipment, when limited quantities of materials are required and when only small additional/top-up quantities are required during the execution of the project.

As per attached letter from Dresser, regarding trim materials, "3.2 is not a feasible option, all these materials are supplied through authorized and certified dealersẠi

3)As per the Approved ITP(VEN-4151-DGTYP-0-04-0001, Rev. A),3.2 certification for trim parts is not required.

A11. Technical justification to deviate: (Describe in detail the benefits in accepting the proposed deviasion. (Attach continuation sheets) if necessary).

- Trim materials are certified according to NACE. Bodies and Bonnets (Pressure Containing Parts) are also certified NACE and having 3.2 Mechanical Properties and Chemical Analysis certificates.
- The valves have been and are being manufactured according to approved QCP VEN-4151-DGTYP-0-04-0001, Rev. A which require 3.2 certification for Mechanical Properties and Chemical Analysis only for Parts Under Pressure (Pressure containing Parts).

As per QP-STD-R-00 1 Rev. 3 clause 4.1 definitions: Pressure Containing Parts areạẠThose parts whose loss of integrity under design conditions would result in a release of retained fluid to the atmosphere e.g., vessel walls, valve bodies and bonnets.

Approved PMI procedure SOK6749263 foresees PMI inspection on External Body only.

3)Considering the above, request QP approval for material certification with EN 10204 3.1 in place of 3.2 with the PMI as Verification test on KN Valves duly witnessed by Approved TPCA.

3) For the Anti-surge Valves belongs to (KN), BH shall perform Chemical Verification test shall be performed on Trims parts dulywitnessed by Approved TPCA.

A12. Cost and Schedule Impact of proposed deviation*: (Attach supporting notes to applicable boxes below and tick the appropriate box below. Attach continuation sheets). if necessary):

- Cost: Provide impact of proposed deviation in QAR for all impacted Item Reference(s) in the Schedule of Prices / Unit Rates.
- Schedule: Provide proposed revised Schedule highlighting the impact of Deviation.
- Zero Cost / Schedule Impact: Provide substantiation and supporting documentation, even if so proposed

* Cost and Schedule Impact for the proposed deviation are not applicable for TDRs raised during Study / FEED

A13. List of documents

Attachment-1 Clarification Letter x Nuovo Pignone ASV

attached:

Ittachment-2 Dresser Valve components list

Ittachment-3 VEN-4151-DGTYP-0-04-0001, Rev. A -ASV

Attachment-4 PMI Procedure

Attachment-S MTC

A14. Authorized Representative / Originator:

Signature:

Date:

18-03-20211

Note1: This TDR is applicable only for the referenced Contract (in item A3 above) as a one-time departure from Project Specifications, granted case-by-case and does not constitute an amendment to the Project Specification and is not to be used as a basis for future departures. Moreover, the acceptance or rejection of this TDR is not to be considered for generalized application to deviate in other similar or recurrent cases, activities, locations, equipment of this project.
